verdict.rationale: v0 docs describe first-party integrations for databases (Neon Postgres, Upstash Redis) and backend services (Supabase) directly inside a Project, and claim v0 'connects to databases as it builds', supporting in-builder wiring without leaving the tool. However, evidence is all first-party docs with no independent/hands-on account of the actual provisioning flow (e.g., creating a new DB instance vs. just linking an existing one), and no detail on setup friction. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the provisioning UX, clarity on whether v0 creates a new database or only links pre-existing ones, and confirmation that environment variables/config are auto-wired without manual steps.
